  1202:     // A complex value is two contiguous elements of its real type, so it is
  1203:     // twice as wide and no more strictly aligned. Clang agrees on all three
  1204:     // for every target here: sizeof/_Alignof are {8,4}, {16,8} and
  1205:     // {2*sizeof(long double), _Alignof(long double)}.
  1206:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT16_COMPLEX:
  1207:         size = layout.float16_type.size * 2;
  1208:         alignment = layout.float16_type.alignment;
  1209:         break;
  1210:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT_COMPLEX:
  1211:         size = layout.float_type.size * 2;
  1212:         alignment = layout.float_type.alignment;
  1213:         break;
  1214:     case C_TYPE_DOUBLE_COMPLEX:
  1215:         size = layout.double_type.size * 2;
  1216:         alignment = layout.double_type.alignment;
  1217:         break;
  1218:     case C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE_COMPLEX:
  1219:         size = layout.long_double_type.size * 2;
  1220:         alignment = layout.long_double_type.alignment;
  1221:         break;
  1222:     case C_TYPE_INT128:
  1223:         size = layout.integer128.size;
  1224:         alignment = layout.integer128.alignment;
  1225:         break;
  1226:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128:
  1227:         size = layout.unsigned_integer128.size;
  1228:         alignment = layout.unsigned_integer128.alignment;
  1229:         break;
  1230:     case C_TYPE_VA_LIST:
  1231:         size = layout.va_list.size;
  1232:         alignment = layout.va_list.alignment;
  1233:         break;
  1234:     // GNU gives `void` a size and an alignment of one so that arithmetic on a
  1235:     // `void *` steps by bytes; clang and gcc both fold `sizeof(void)`,
  1236:     // `sizeof(const void)` and `_Alignof(void)` to 1. It is an extension for
  1237:     // that arithmetic and for `sizeof`, never a licence to declare a `void`
  1238:     // object: every refusal of one keys on the *kind*, not on a zero size.
  1239:     case C_TYPE_VOID:
  1240:         size = 1;
  1241:         alignment = 1;
  1242:         break;
  1243:     case C_TYPE_ARRAY:
  1244:     case C_TYPE_VECTOR:
  1245:     case C_TYPE_STRUCT:
  1246:     case C_TYPE_UNION:
  1247:     case C_TYPE_ENUM:
  1248:     case C_TYPE_INVALID:
  1249:     case C_TYPE_COUNT:
  1250:         return false;
  1251:     }
  1252:     *size_out = size;
  1253:     *alignment_out = alignment;
  1254:     return true;
  1255: }
  1256:

  1261:    the record itself is three bytes aligned one, and what gives every atomic

  1257: /* The layout `_Atomic T` has, given T's own.  Clang treats `_Atomic T` as
  1258:    *constructing* a type rather than qualifying one: a value it could operate on

  7575: // Does the identifier at `index` name a type on its own?  The answer comes
  7576: // from c_ir_primitive_type_kind run over that one token: a word the scan
  7577: // collects names a type, and a qualifier, storage class or function
  7578: // specifier it steps over does not -- so the question is asked of the same
  7579: // ladder the specifier sets are built from and no second list of spellings
  7580: // can drift from it.  A tag keyword names a type through the aggregate
  7581: // branch rather than the scan, and is read from the well-known set that
  7582: // branch already tests.  Callers ask it of a word standing beside a type
  7583: // that is spelled some other way, where a second type specifier is the
  7584: // constraint violation C_DIAGNOSTIC_INVALID_TYPE_SPECIFIERS reports.
  7585: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_type_specifier_token(CPreprocessResult preprocess, u32 index)
  7586: {
  7587:     u32 declarator_start = index;
  7588:     u32 invalid_specifier = UINT32_MAX;
  7589:     CTypeKind kind = c_ir_primitive_type_kind(preprocess, index, index + 1, &declarator_start, &invalid_specifier);
  7590:     return kind != C_TYPE_INVALID || invalid_specifier != UINT32_MAX ||
  7591:            c_token_in_well_known_set(preprocess.spelling_base, preprocess.tokens[index], C_PARSE_AGGREGATE_KEYWORDS);
  7592: }

 13104:         }

 13107:         {

 13111:         if (type_id.value >= result->type_count)
 13112:         {
 13113:             continue;
 13114:         }

 13116:         if (kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG ||
 13117:             kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128)
 13118:         {

 13125: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_record_constexpr_integer(CTypeParseMachine* machine, Arena* arena, CParseResult* result,
 13126:                                                           CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, CEntityId entity_id, u32 initializer_start,
